note: The catalogue-to-Android-resources rule (README.md, reference implementation apps/web/scripts/i18n-android.mjs). catalogue: the language's catalogue; en: the English catalogue that fixes argument positions (absent: the catalogue is English); notes: translator notes. output: the whole strings.xml text. Keys sorted; name = segments joined by _; plain message -> <string>, plural -> <plurals> with one <item> per category of the message in its order; # and the plural argument -> %1$s; other arguments %N$s in order of first appearance in the English message (after the count in a plural); XML-escape & < >; escape ' " \ with \; % -> %% only in a string with arguments or a plural; a leading @ or ? escaped with \; a newline -> \n; a leading or trailing space and a space after a space -> \u0020; <tag>..</tag> -> <annotation tag="tag">..</annotation>; a note -> <!-- note --> above the item (-- written - -); a key missing from the English catalogue is left out.

cases.name: plain messages; keys become names joined by _, sorted
plural: # is argument 1, other arguments follow

catalogue.study.due.count: {count, plural, one {# card due in {deck}} other {# cards due in {deck}}}

cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <plurals name="study_due_count">
        <item quantity="one">%1$s card due in %2$s</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$s cards due in %2$s</item>
    </plurals>
</resources>

cases.name: plural argument named in a branch is argument 1
cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <plurals name="study_items">
        <item quantity="one">%1$s item</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$s items</item>
    </plurals>
</resources>

cases.name: tags become annotations
cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <string name="sources_intro">Read the <annotation tag="link">notes</annotation> & <annotation tag="strong">%1$s</annotation> more</string>
</resources>

cases.name: percent doubled only where the string is formatted
cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <string name="stats_done">%1$s%% done</string>
    <plurals name="stats_share">
        <item quantity="one">%1$s card, 5%%</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$s cards, 5%%</item>
    </plurals>
    <string name="stats_sure">100% sure</string>
</resources>

cases.name: newline and significant spaces
cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <string name="app_lines">Line one\nLine two</string>
    <string name="app_spaced">\u0020two \u0020spaces\u0020</string>
</resources>

cases.name: notes become comments above the item, -- broken up
cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <!-- The product name - - never translated -->
    <string name="app_name">qinqin</string>
    <string name="app_tagline">Learn every day</string>
</resources>

cases.name: a translation takes argument positions from English; keys missing in English are left out
a plural translation keeps its own categories

catalogue.study.due.count: {count, plural, one {# карточка в {deck}} few {# карточки в {deck}} many {# карточек в {deck}} other {# карточки в {deck}}}

en.study.due.count: {count, plural, one {# card in {deck}} other {# cards in {deck}}}

cases.output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
    <plurals name="study_due_count">
        <item quantity="one">%1$s карточка в %2$s</item>
        <item quantity="few">%1$s карточки в %2$s</item>
        <item quantity="many">%1$s карточек в %2$s</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$s карточки в %2$s</item>
    </plurals>
</resources>
